query:
SELECT et.id, em.subject as "subject?"
            FROM email_threads et
            LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT m.subject
                FROM email_messages m
                WHERE m.thread_id = et.id AND m.is_draft = false
                ORDER BY m.internal_date_ts DESC NULLS LAST
                LIMIT 1
            ) em ON true
            WHERE et.id = ANY($1)
